ideas.pitch: An embedded hardware safety module that automatically detects crash impacts using IMUs and transmits encrypted SOS packets via an off-grid acoustic/RF mesh when cellular networks fail.
ideas.problem_statement: Hardware Track - Real-world IoT and safety challenges in transportation and communication.
ideas.title: AutoSOS ECE: ESP32-Based Post-Accident Vehicle Emergency Mesh
ideas.why_it_could_win: Hardware and IoT projects that bring physical safety devices with working live demos consistently win physical hackathons like Kernel Prime, appealing directly to ECE/EE judges.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight custom pipeline implemented on an FPGA to monitor high-frequency sensor streams from industrial motors and detect anomalies instantly without cloud roundtrips.
ideas.problem_statement: Hardware Track - Industrial automation and low-power hardware optimization.
ideas.title: VLSI-Edge: FPGA-Accelerated Real-Time Anomaly Detection for Industrial IoT
ideas.why_it_could_win: Organized by the Departments of ECE & EE (VLSI Design & Technology), hardware optimization and FPGA-oriented solutions directly align with the department's core evaluation preferences.

ideas.pitch: A compact smart waste bin prototype using a camera, lightweight object detection, and servo-driven flaps to classify and separate biodegradable, plastic, and metallic trash in real time.
ideas.problem_statement: Hardware & Software Track - Smart city and environmental hygiene challenges.
ideas.title: SmartBin AI: Edge-Vision Waste Segregator with Automated Sorting Mechanism
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines computer vision with a functional hardware sorting mechanism, matching the winning formula of physical robotics builds that perform live, reliable demonstrations.

ideas.pitch: A decentralized, battery-powered emergency intercom mesh that routes audio and text data across campus zones during power outages using inexpensive transceiver modules.
ideas.problem_statement: Hardware Track - Robust local communication and disaster management systems.
ideas.title: EcoMesh Campus: Ultra-Fast LoRa/Radio Emergency Broadcast Network
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses critical campus infrastructure problems with a tangible, hardware-heavy network architecture that judges can test live during the 24-hour window.

ideas.pitch: A custom relay and current-sensing circuit designed to monitor appliance loads, prevent overloads, and report metrics over a local web dashboard for energy conservation.
ideas.problem_statement: Hardware & Software Track - Electrical energy monitoring and efficiency.
ideas.title: GridGuard: Low-Cost Microcontroller-Based Smart Power Tap Controller
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly appeals to the Electrical Engineering department co-organizing the event by targeting core power management and circuit design principles.
